purpose: Durable human review of one exact deployment-drift evidence pack before bounded review evidence may be accepted for candidate intake.
rules: A review artifact is bound to one app, repository, reviewed commit, observed deployed commit and deployment observation id.
The workspace surfaces security/auth, API/server, database/migration, dependency/build and CI/deployment paths before tests and other paths.
A reviewer may record bounded notes and findings for changed files without changing candidate, checklist or certification state.
Every changed file must have a human finding before evidence can be accepted.
Any reviewed_blocker finding prevents ACCEPT EVIDENCE.
Acceptance requires the literal confirmation ACCEPT EVIDENCE, a reviewer id, reviewedAt timestamp and bounded summary.
Acceptance creates a separate candidate-intake-compatible evidence record with source github and kind security_diff_review.
The accepted evidence record is bound to the exact reviewed...observed commit comparison and includes the human reviewer id in its bounded summary.
Evidence acceptance does not create a pending_review candidate; candidate materialization/intake remain separate guarded actions.
An accepted review artifact is immutable in workspace v1.
nonClaims: reviewed_no_issue does not prove a file is bug-free or secure.
Evidence acceptance is not checklist approval or Defence certification.
The workspace does not replace review of underlying code, tests or runtime behaviour when needed.
